scripts.gate: npm run gate:fmt && npm run gate:clippy && npm run gate:test && npm run gate:tagging && npm run gate:faces && npm run gate:audit
scripts.gate:test: npm run build && npm run check && npm test && cargo test --workspace
scripts.gate:tagging: cargo clippy -p eonsort-core --features tagging,quality --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p eonsort-core --features tagging,quality
scripts.gate:faces: cargo clippy -p eonsort-core --features faces --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p eonsort-core --features faces
scripts.icon: node scripts/make-icon.mjs src-tauri/icons/source.png && tauri icon src-tauri/icons/source.png
